brief: Eight AI revenue streams ranked by effort versus payout. From easiest to hardest, what actually pays in 2026.

slots.desc1: Sell prompt packs and templates with zero upfront cost.
slots.desc2: Curated AI news that readers actually pay to open.
slots.desc3: Custom GPTs and agents businesses pay monthly to keep.
slots.desc4: Faceless channels using AI voice, script, and thumbnail tools.
slots.desc5: Ship one-feature SaaS tools that solve a single pain.

slots.toolTagline: The fastest way to turn prompts into passive product income.
slots.bigStatement: Package your best ChatGPT prompts into a digital product buyers download in seconds.
slots.use1Body: 50 viral hook templates founders copy and paste every morning.
slots.use2Body: Debug and refactor prompts developers run inside VS Code daily.
slots.use3Body: AI art directions graphic designers feed straight into Midjourney queues.

slots.toolTagline: A weekly AI digest that sponsors pay to reach.
slots.bigStatement: Use AI to curate and draft niche news readers open before coffee every day.
slots.use1Body: Algorithmic summaries of papers and launches sent at 8 AM.
slots.use2Body: Tools for lawyers, teachers, or designers collected by AI scouts.
slots.use3Body: Paid placements from AI startups wanting access to your engaged list.

slots.toolTagline: Custom GPTs that answer support tickets while you sleep.
slots.bigStatement: Build agents that book meetings, qualify leads, and close tickets without code.
slots.use1Body: Instant replies trained on your docs that cut ticket volume 70%.
slots.use2Body: Conversational forms that score prospects before they hit your calendar.
slots.use3Body: AI receptionists that check availability and schedule calls via chat.

slots.toolTagline: Faceless channels powered by AI script, voice, and edit.
slots.bigStatement: Publish daily videos in under an hour without showing your face or studio.
slots.use1Body: Screen recordings narrated by AI voices that teach software workflows.
slots.use2Body: Top-ten rundowns generated from transcripts and cut with auto-editors.
slots.use3Body: Short-form clips summarizing tech news for TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

slots.toolTagline: Ship one-feature tools that users pay monthly to access.
slots.bigStatement: Wrap a single OpenAI call into a UI and charge $9 a month forever.
slots.use1Body: Browser plugins that summarize pages or rewrite emails with one click.
slots.use2Body: Simplified interfaces for complex models non-developers can actually use.
slots.use3Body: Embeddable AI components agencies white-label for their own client sites.

slots.toolTagline: High-ticket AI implementation for businesses that need custom workflows.
slots.bigStatement: Charge premium rates to integrate AI into ops, marketing, and customer success stacks.
slots.use1Body: Map where AI cuts costs and speed up delivery for clients.
slots.use2Body: Automated pipelines connecting CRM, email, and AI models they already use.
slots.use3Body: Workshops that teach staff to prompt and deploy models correctly.

slots.body: Choose one stream, ship your first version this weekend, then iterate toward profit.
